title: Senior Director Group Financial Planning & Analysis
description:
Lead Group FP&A and performance management, driving the transformation toward a more forward-looking, data-driven finance function.
 Own the Group’s long-range planning, budgeting and rolling forecasting, ensuring alignment across Business Units and corporate functions.
 Translate business strategy into financial targets, integrated plans and scenarios, providing an independent Group perspective on performance and outlook.
 Drive performance management across key financial and operational indicators, including profitability, backlog, working capital, cash, risks and opportunities.
 Act as a strategic finance partner to senior leadership, providing clear insights, recommendations and decision support on business performance and strategic priorities.
 Support growth initiatives, resource allocation, investments and M&A through robust financial modelling and scenario analysis.
 Lead Group management reporting and the FP&A organisation / Center of Excellence, strengthening standards, business partnering and cross-functional collaboration.
 Advance digital FP&A capabilities through EPM, BI, automation, analytics and AI to improve the speed, accuracy and quality of financial insights. 15+ years of progressive finance experience, including senior leadership experience in Group FP&A, Financial Controlling or Corporate Performance Management.
 Strong expertise in strategic planning, budgeting, forecasting, management reporting and performance management.
 Proven experience within a complex international organisation, ideally in an industrial or project-based business environment.
 Strong understanding of profitability, backlog, working capital, cash flow, cost structures and operational performance drivers.
 Proven ability to partner with and influence CFOs, executive leadership and Business Unit leaders in complex decision-making.
 Demonstrated experience building, leading or transforming FP&A or controlling functions toward more analytical, driver-based and forward-looking ways of working.
 Advanced capabilities in financial modelling, scenario planning and digital finance, including EPM, BI, automation and analytics.
 Fluent business English with strong executive communication and leadership skills and the ability to operate effectively in a global matrix organisation. We offer 

• Responsible challenge with diversified field of activity

• Team-oriented working atmosphere in an international Company

• Personal development opportunities through own Inova Academy

• Opportunity to gain an insight into various technical disciplines

• Excellent employment conditions

• Attractive working place (central, good transport links)

• Modern infrastructure
 
 For HR agencies: Please note that we do not accept applications coming from agencies. Thank you.
